reading: The sketch builds a week-view calendar: a header with a bold month title and nav/view links, a row of day-of-week column heads, an hourly time rail, a week grid filled with color-coded, time-positioned event cards (per the detailed typed note), an extra off-white "Launch sync" card, and a red current-time indicator line with a dot.

actions.instruction: Calendar header: bold 22px heading "October 2026" followed by nav links Today, ‹, ›, and view-switch links Day, Week, Month.
Row of day-of-week header links acting as the 7 day-column heads above the week grid: MON 19, TUE 20, WED 21, THU 22, FRI 23, SAT 24, SUN 25.
Vertical strip of thin hour gridlines down the left edge of the calendar, labeled 8 AM through 6 PM, to anchor the rows of the week grid.
Week grid with 7 day columns under the day heads and thin hour rows from 8 AM to 6 PM. Place event cards by day/time, each with a pale fill, a darker left edge
An off-white event card reading "Launch sync 11:00–12:30", placed within the week grid alongside the other event cards.
